- Generates professional reports tailored for all major departments (CEO, CFO, CTO, Marketing, Commercial, Legal, HR).
- Supports competitive landscape mapping, TAM/SAM/SOM calculation, pricing analysis, OSINT gathering, and automated monitoring.
